document_summary: Part 1 of 6 of Newark, NJ Code Chapter 2:10 (Department of Economic and Housing Development), covering the table of contents and the department's divisions and homeowner and housing assistance programs; the § 2:10-11 unconscionable rent increase text is listed in the contents but does not appear in this part. | Part 2 of 6 of Newark, NJ municipal code (Title 2, Chapter 10) text on abandoned property tax-lien sales, rehabilitation and a senior homeowner repair program; it contains no rent control, eviction, deposit, screening or algorithmic rent-setting rules. | Part 3 of an ecode360 capture of Newark, NJ municipal code covering Title 2 provisions on a senior homeowner repair program, vacant-lot leases, vacant and foreclosure property registration, and maintenance, none of which falls within the six rental-housing categories. | Part 4 of 6 of Newark, NJ Revised General Ordinances Title II, Chapter 10 (Dept. of Economic and Housing Development): foreclosure-property maintenance, planning and board administration, municipal employee housing grants, historic preservation, and a commercial facade loan program, with no rules in the tracked rental categories. | Part 5 of 6 of Newark, NJ municipal code Title 2, Chapter 10 (economic development): Facade Improvement Program, South Ward Rehabilitation Program, and Live Newark Loan Forgiveness Program; it contains no rental-housing rules in the scoped categories. | Part 6 of 6 of Newark, NJ City Code Title 2, Chapter 10 (ecode360): Live Newark loan default provisions, the Employee Ownership Loan Program, the affordable-housing deed restriction on City land sales, the Homeownership Revitalization Program, and only the opening definition of the Unconscionable Rent Increase section; it contains no operative rule in the tracked rental categories.
